facts.fact: Lusaka Star reports that Zambia's Data Protection Act has strengthened the legal framework for collecting and processing personal data, with enforcement and compliance still a challenge; the article gives no other date, so as_of is its published date.

Lusaka Star quotes Data Protection Commissioner Likando Luywa speaking on oversight and registration of data controllers and processors, so the Commissioner is in post and acting; the article gives no other date, so as_of is its published date.
